high_level_description: The image depicts a woman standing in front of a bathroom mirror, taking a selfie. She is wearing an elegant black dress with intricate lace detailing on the back. The dress has a crop top design, revealing her midriff. She accessorizes with multiple bangles on her left wrist and a bracelet on her right wrist. Her hair is styled in loose waves, and she appears to be adjusting her hair with her right hand. The setting is a modern bathroom with a large, rectangular mirror mounted above a marble countertop. On the countertop, there is a white sink with a silver faucet.
